name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
author: hello@soneyko.ai
description: Persistent Ubuntu Linux environment with a terminal and apt. Packages and files are kept in the server volume. Uses unprivileged PRoot; no separate kernel, systemd, privileged Docker or host mounts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.instance
echo 'Linux environment will be initialized on first start.'
